sentences.text:
Criminal Procedure vs In Re : Sumit Ghosh & Ors on 19 January,
2023
19.01.2023 sdas Crr No. 3194 of 2016 In Re : An application under Section 482 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure.
And In Re : Sumit Ghosh & Ors. ....... petitioners Nobody appears for the parties.

It appears from this Court's order dated 26.09.2016 that this Court has given liberty to file joint petition of compromise as the petitioner contended that the disputes between the parties have settled due to intervention of the friends, family and well wishers of the parties.
But no such joint petition has been filed till date.
It also appears from the record that it was directed the petitioner to serve copies of the revisional application to the opposite parties and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.

Let copies of the revisional application be served upon the opposite party no. 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit- of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.

It is also directed the petitioner to file a joint petition of compromise as the petitioner pray for quashing of the proceeding being G.R. Case No. 749 of 2009 pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 8th Court, Calcutta arising out of Girish Park Police Station Case No. 56 of 2009 dated 28.04.2009 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code on the ground of compromise.
